name: Orchestrator / Execution Runtime
purpose: Bind N00-N15 into one controlled execution runtime where the backend owns command routing, state transitions, dispatch, retries, manual fallback, workflow result ingestion, priority lanes, and execution traces.
locked_laws: Backend orchestrator controls all application state transitions.
n8n workers remain stateless thin workers.
A worker may execute a domain task but may not govern final state by itself.
Every worker result must return through /workflow/result or equivalent backend result ingestion.
Every orchestration run needs idempotency, evidence, trace, and final state guard.
Same-state workers must never advance candidate/application state.
W24 command routes through W17 before worker dispatch.
Playwright is scout/probe only; blocked/CAPTCHA/OTP/down/manual-only creates MAP handoff.
Priority lanes change order and intensity, not user dignity or sector access.
Human approval is required for submission, refund, fraud, privacy, official-status, and hard-blocker decisions.
Oracle Lite cap controls throughput only; capability remains national.
No silent retry storms; retries are capped and visible in evidence.
Failed execution must produce reason, fix path, and manual/Phoenix fallback where appropriate.
